faqs.a: A VPN encrypts your internet connection and routes your traffic through a secure server, which hides your real IP address and protects your data from being intercepted on public or untrusted networks. OmniGuard's VPN service is included as part of our security plans.

Data broker removal is the process of identifying companies that collect and sell your personal information online and submitting requests to have your data taken down from their databases. OmniGuard handles this removal process on your behalf as part of our privacy protection service.

brand_notes: Must never mention cannabis in any form.
Must never reveal 'AI' branding or internal AI tooling to end users — keep all answers framed as a security/privacy product, not an AI product.

faqs.a: PrimeDox offers AI-assisted document generation, including legal templates that can help you prepare drafts such as affidavits. Generated documents are templates and starting points — for anything filed with a court, have a qualified professional review the final document before submission.

faqs.q: How do I track my case?
faqs.a: PrimeDox includes case tracking tools so you can follow the status and key dates of your matter in one place. For specific account or case access issues, your request will be routed internally to the correct specialist.

faqs.q: How do I follow Francisco v. Denby?
faqs.a: Francisco v. Denby is one of the active cases tracked on the CCLDR / Doc Weedlaw site. Court filings and case summaries are free and public. Full case timelines, document downloads, and Derek's strategy commentary are available to subscribers — see cases.html#pricing for subscription tiers.

ccldr-weedlaw.pricing: Free summary tier; paid detailed access via subscription (see cases.html#pricing — $49/$99/$299 per month)
